passages.excerpt_preview: Government partnership later became central to its development and to India’s atomic-energy program.
hysicist Homi J. Bhabha proposed an institute for fundamental research during the 1940s.

passages.locator: organizational ally rather than as the scientist
passages.excerpt_preview: The institutional history shows Tata acting as sponsor and organizational ally rather than as the scientist who designed the research program.
Tata and the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust supported the proposal, and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research was founded in 1945.
